title: fix(plugin-form): keep a 1rem viewport gutter on lg/xl ModalForm dialogs from sm up (objectui#12593)
body:
Fixes #12593
Clause-②: no

## What changed

`ModalForm`'s two bounded wide sizes are `lg` (`sm:max-w-2xl`, 672px) and `xl` (`sm:max-w-5xl`, 1024px). They now also read ONE shared class, `BOUNDED_SIZE_VIEWPORT_GUTTER = 'sm:w-[calc(100%-2rem)]'`, defined once in `ModalForm.tsx` next to `modalSizeClasses`.

- The dialog is now the smaller of its max width and the window less 2rem.
- The primitive's `left-[50%]` and `translate-x-[-50%]` centre it, so it keeps 1rem on each side at every width from `sm` up.
- Above the max width plus 2rem (1056px for `xl`, 704px for `lg`), each size is exactly as wide as before.

The class strings stay literal in source, so Tailwind's scanner sees both. The 2rem literal is written once.

**Unchanged:**
- `sm` (`sm:max-w-sm`), `default` (`sm:max-w-lg`) and `full` (`sm:max-w-[95vw] sm:w-full`);
- the phone sheet below `sm`;
- the height rules `h-[100dvh] sm:h-auto sm:max-h-[90vh]`;
- the interim bound and the density rule from PR #12546.

There is no edit to `packages/components/**`, `custom/mobile-dialog-content.tsx`, any app-shell host or any other dialog. Nothing is added: no prop, export, type member or `modalSize` value.

**Files:**
- `packages/plugin-form/src/ModalForm.tsx`: the constant and the `lg` / `xl` rows of the map;
- new pin `packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/modalViewportGutter-12593.test.tsx`;
- `.changeset/12593-modal-viewport-gutter.md` (`@object-ui/plugin-form`, patch).

## Mechanism assumptions, as measured

- **A1: the class is emitted. Holds.** I ran the console's own Tailwind step: `@tailwindcss/postcss`, the plugin `apps/console/postcss.config.js` names, over `apps/console/src/index.css`. That file's `@source` lines include `packages/plugin-form/src` and exclude `__tests__`.
  - The emitted sheet has `width: calc(100% - 2rem)` under the selector for `sm:w-[calc(100%-2rem)]`.
  - That rule sits inside the `sm` media query (a width of at least 40rem), after the base `.w-full` rule.
  - At the base commit, no tracked source spells the class: `git grep` exits 1. The control, `sm:max-w-5xl` in `ModalForm.tsx`, exits 0. So the emitted rule comes from this change.
- **A2: the width resolves against the viewport. Holds; `100%` was chosen.** The dialog is `fixed`, so `100%` is its containing block: the viewport less any classic scrollbar, the same box `left-[50%]` centres in.
  - Measured in Chromium with classic scrollbars: I turned off Playwright's `--hide-scrollbars` and made the page scroll, which gives a 10px scrollbar.
  - The `100%` form gives 16/16px gutters at 1024 and at 768.
  - A `calc(100vw - 2rem)` width, tried in the harness only, gives 11/11px: each gutter loses half the scrollbar.
- **A3: the 12521 pins need new class strings. Does not hold; they are unchanged and keep their meaning.**
  - The chosen shape keeps `sm:max-w-5xl` / `sm:max-w-2xl` as their own tokens and adds a separate width token.
  - So `toContain('sm:max-w-5xl')` (a heavy object opens `xl`) and `toContain('sm:max-w-2xl')` (a light one opens `lg`) pass as written, in `dialogDefaultLayout-12521.test.tsx` and in app-shell's `AppContent.recordDialogInterimBound-12521.test.tsx`.
  - A rewrite would only be needed for a `min(...)` max-width shape. That shape writes the 2rem literal once per size, so it was not taken.

## Real-layout reading (Chromium, static harness)

The harness is the dialog element's class list from a real `ModalForm` render, after `tailwind-merge`, over the console's emitted CSS. It ran in headless Chromium 1194 at a viewport height of 900. "Before" is the same class list without the gutter token. Each cell is width · left/right gutter, in px.

The `sm`, `default` and `full` columns read the same before and after. Their class lists do not change.

## What the landing seat's browser reading should show

HotCRM Leads → New. It is a field-heavy create, so it opens `xl`, as the card measured. The numbers are predicted from the harness above:

| Viewport | Dialog width | Left gutter | Right gutter |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 1440 × 900 | 1024px, unchanged | 208px | 208px |
| 1024 × 768 | 992px | 16px | 16px |
| 768 | 736px | 16px | 16px |
| 390 | 390px, the full-screen sheet, unchanged | 0 | 0 |

At 1024 and 768, the card measured the base at 1024px and 768px, both at x = 0. A reading that still shows x = 0 means the console CSS it served was not rebuilt from this head.

## Tests and gates

Run on head `c57843d95d` unless a line names another commit. Heavy runs went through the shared verify lock. CI runs the full farm.

- **New pin `modalViewportGutter-12593.test.tsx`, 4 tests:**
  - `lg` and `xl` each carry exactly one sm-tier width, the same gutter token, and keep their own max width;
  - the field-heavy default (no authored size) carries it;
  - against `default`, `lg` / `xl` differ only in `sm:`-prefixed tokens, and the phone sheet and height classes are still present;
  - CONTROL: `sm`, `default` and `full` read no gutter.
- **Every `@object-ui/plugin-form` suite:** `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-form/` gave Test Files 187 passed (187), Tests 2291 passed, 1 skipped (2292). The run printed `c57843d95d` as its head. The new pin plus both 12521 files, including app-shell's, also ran on their own: 3 files, 26 tests passed.
- **Type-check:** `pnpm turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/plugin-form^...' --concurrency=2` exited 0 (11 tasks). Then `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-form type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) exited 0. `--listFiles` shows that `tsconfig.test.json` compiles the new pin.
- **ESLint** on the two changed source files exited 0, with 0 errors. The new pin has no warnings; `ModalForm.tsx`'s warnings were all there before this change.
- **Census and ratchet sweep, 8 files, 173 tests passed:**
  - `product-neutral-renderer.ratchet`, `no-component-any-cast.ratchet`, `iconOnlyButtonCensus-12143`, `ariaLabelLiteralCensus-12145`;
  - `changeset-polarity-census`, `check-changeset-no-major`;
  - `test-file-timings`, `test-shard-partition`.
- **Changeset gates, each exit 0:** `check-changeset-presence` (1 changeset declared for 2 source files of 1 released package), `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-overwrite`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `census:changeset-polarity`.
- **`check:control-bytes` and `check:new-line-citations`** exit 0 on `c57843d95d`, with 0 new citations.
- **Other gates, each exit 0:** `check:phantom-deps`, `check:self-import`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:metadata-write-doors`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:published-tsconfig-exclude`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:shell-escape-residue`.
- **Governed surface:** `check-governed-queue-guard --test` on the three paths answers NOT GOVERNED.

## Ablation

The fix was committed first. The mutation went through `ablation-replace` with a trapped restore: the constant's value `'sm:w-[calc(100%-2rem)]'` became `''`. On disk the anchor count went from 1 to 0 and the blob changed.

- The three margin pins went red: `lg and xl both carry the one shared gutter`, `a field-heavy dialog … carries it` and `below sm nothing changes …`.
- The CONTROL pin stayed green: Tests 3 failed, 1 passed (4).
- After the restore, the blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Acceptance notes

- **Out of scope, the same defect in another dialog: app-shell's `useActionModal`.** This is the console's `type: 'modal'` action path, and the dispatch keeps it off this PR.
  - Its `SIZE_CLASS` maps `lg` to `sm:max-w-2xl` and `xl` to `sm:max-w-5xl` on the Shadcn `DialogContent` primitive's `w-full max-w-lg`.
  - A page-target modal with no declared size resolves to `xl`.
  - Same harness, over the same console CSS: 1440 gives 1024 · 208/208, 1024 gives 1024 · 0/0, and 768 gives 768 · 0/0.
  - Named producer: objectstack `examples/app-showcase`'s `showcase_quick_view` (`type: 'modal'`, target page `showcase_component_gallery`, no size).
  - It is reported to the seat to file. It is not filed from here, and not fixed here.
- The dialog-size paragraph in `content/docs/plugins/plugin-form.mdx` states no widths, so nothing in it becomes false. No docs edit.
